note: Plain-language, original paraphrases of how each MTG keyword functions (game rules aren't copyrightable; only Wizards' exact wording is, so nothing here is copied verbatim). Keyed by the keyword name lowercased, matched case-insensitively against a card's Scryfall `keywords`. Each entry carries a `type`: 'ability' (keyword ability — a property the card has), 'action' (keyword action — a verb a player performs), or 'ability_word' (an italic flavour label with no rules of its own). Names sourced from Scryfall catalogs /keyword-abilities, /keyword-actions, /ability-words. Definitions for the newest sets (2025+) are best-effort and easy to refine — a keyword with no entry just renders as a non-tappable chip.

flying.definition: Can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach.

trample.definition: Combat damage beyond what's needed to destroy its blockers is dealt to the player or planeswalker.

vigilance.definition: Attacking doesn't cause it to tap.

haste.definition: Can attack and use tap abilities the turn it comes under your control.

lifelink.definition: Damage it deals also causes its controller to gain that much life.

deathtouch.definition: Any amount of damage it deals to a creature is enough to destroy that creature.

first strike.definition: Deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.

double strike.definition: Deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.

menace.definition: Can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.

hexproof.definition: Can't be the target of spells or abilities opponents control.

hexproof from.definition: Can't be the target of spells or abilities of the named quality that opponents control.

shroud.definition: Can't be the target of any spells or abilities.

indestructible.definition: Can't be destroyed by damage or by effects that say destroy.

flash.definition: You may cast it any time you could cast an instant.

ward.definition: When it becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays the ward cost.

protection.definition: Can't be blocked, targeted, dealt damage, enchanted, or equipped by anything with the named quality.

prowess.definition: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

infect.definition: Deals damage to creatures as -1/-1 counters and to players as poison counters.

wither.definition: Deals damage to creatures as -1/-1 counters.

toxic.definition: A player dealt combat damage by it also gets that many poison counters.

poisonous.definition: Whenever it deals combat damage to a player, that player gets that many poison counters.

fear.definition: Can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and black creatures.

intimidate.definition: Can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and creatures that share a color with it.

skulk.definition: Can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.

shadow.definition: Can block or be blocked only by creatures with shadow.

horsemanship.definition: Can only be blocked by creatures with horsemanship.

flanking.definition: When a creature without flanking blocks it, the blocker gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

banding.definition: Helps creatures attack and block together; you choose how combat damage is assigned.

rampage.definition: Whenever it becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N for each creature blocking it beyond the first.

bushido.definition: Whenever it blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N until end of turn.

frenzy.definition: Whenever it attacks and isn't blocked, it gets +N/+0 until end of turn.

melee.definition: Whenever it attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat.

battle cry.definition: Whenever it attacks, each other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

exalted.definition: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

mentor.definition: Whenever it attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on a target attacking creature with lesser power.

training.definition: Whenever it attacks with another creature of greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

dethrone.definition: Whenever it attacks the player with the most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

afflict.definition: Whenever it becomes blocked, the defending player loses that much life.

annihilator.definition: Whenever it attacks, the defending player sacrifices that many permanents.

provoke.definition: Whenever it attacks, you may have a target creature the defending player controls untap and block it if able.

enlist.definition: As it attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control to add its power to this creature for the combat.

myriad.definition: Whenever it attacks, for each other opponent you may create a tapped, attacking token copy attacking that player; exile the copies at end of combat.

mobilize.definition: Whenever it attacks, create that many 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens tapped and attacking; sacrifice them at the next end step.

decayed.definition: It can't block, and when it attacks you sacrifice it at end of combat.

renown.definition: When it deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put that many +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes renowned.

boast.definition: Activate its boast ability only if it attacked this turn, and only once each turn.

prowl.definition: You may cast it for its cheaper prowl cost if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with a Rogue or a creature of the listed type.

dash.definition: You may cast it for its dash cost; it gains haste and returns to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.

blitz.definition: You may cast it for its blitz cost; it gains haste, draws you a card when it dies, and is sacrificed at the next end step.

freerunning.definition: You may cast it for its cheaper freerunning cost if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with an Assassin or your commander.

web-slinging.definition: You may cast it for its web-slinging cost, which includes returning a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.

unleash.definition: It may enter with a +1/+1 counter; if it has one, it can't block.

bloodthirst.definition: If an opponent was dealt damage this turn, it enters with that many +1/+1 counters.

sunburst.definition: Enters with a +1/+1 (or charge) counter for each color of mana spent to cast it.

fabricate.definition: When it enters, put that many +1/+1 counters on it, or instead create that many 1/1 colorless Servo artifact tokens.

graft.definition: Enters with that many +1/+1 counters; whenever another creature enters, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this onto it.

modular.definition: Enters with that many +1/+1 counters; when it dies, you may move those counters onto a target artifact creature.

evolve.definition: Whenever a creature with greater power or toughness enters under your control, put a +1/+1 counter on this.

amplify.definition: As it enters, you may reveal any number of cards sharing a listed creature type from your hand; it gets that many +1/+1 counters.

devour.definition: As it enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures; it enters with that many (times the devour number) +1/+1 counters.

tribute.definition: As it enters, an opponent chooses whether to put that many +1/+1 counters on it; if they don't, its tribute ability triggers.

ravenous.definition: Enters with X +1/+1 counters; if X is 5 or more, draw a card.

backup.definition: When it enters, put that many +1/+1 counters on a creature; if it's another creature, it also gains this creature's other abilities until end of turn.

afterlife.definition: When it dies, create that many 1/1 white and black Spirit creature tokens with flying.

undying.definition: When it dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters, return it to the battlefield with one.

persist.definition: When it dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters, return it to the battlefield with one.

soulshift.definition: When it dies, you may return a target Spirit card with mana value N or less from your graveyard to your hand.

recover.definition: When a creature dies, you may pay its recover cost to return it from your graveyard to your hand; otherwise exile it.

haunt.definition: When it dies, exile it haunting a target creature; its triggered effect happens again when that haunted creature dies.

exploit.definition: When it enters, you may sacrifice a creature; if you do, its exploit ability triggers.

champion.definition: When it enters, exile another creature you control until it leaves the battlefield.

soulbond.definition: When it or another creature enters, you may pair the two; the paired creatures share a bonus until one leaves.

evoke.definition: You may cast it for its evoke cost, but sacrifice it when it enters.

emerge.definition: You may cast it for its emerge cost by sacrificing a creature, reducing the cost by that creature's mana value.

offering.definition: You may cast it any time you could cast an instant by sacrificing a creature of the listed type, reducing its cost by that creature's mana cost.

surge.definition: You may cast it for its cheaper surge cost if you or a teammate already cast another spell this turn.

spectacle.definition: You may cast it for its spectacle cost if an opponent lost life this turn.

casualty.definition: As you cast it, you may sacrifice a creature with power N or greater to copy it.

conspire.definition: As you cast it, you may tap two untapped creatures that share a color with it to copy it.

replicate.definition: As you cast it, you may pay its replicate cost any number of times to copy it that many times.

storm.definition: When you cast it, copy it for each other spell cast before it this turn.

gravestorm.definition: When you cast it, copy it for each permanent put into a graveyard this turn.

cascade.definition: When you cast it, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a cheaper nonland card; you may cast that for free, then put the rest on the bottom in random order.

ripple.definition: When you cast it, you may reveal the top N cards of your library and cast any with the same name for free; put the rest on the bottom.

demonstrate.definition: When you cast it, you may copy it; if you do, choose an opponent who also copies it.

squad.definition: As you cast it, you may pay its squad cost any number of times to create that many token copies when it enters.

offspring.definition: As you cast it, you may pay its offspring cost to also create a 1/1 token copy when it enters.

kicker.definition: You may pay an additional cost as you cast it to get a bonus effect.

multikicker.definition: Its kicker cost can be paid any number of times for repeated effects.

entwine.definition: You may pay the entwine cost to choose all of its modes instead of one.

escalate.definition: Pay the escalate cost for each mode you choose beyond the first.

spree.definition: Choose one or more additional modes as you cast it, paying each chosen mode's cost.

overload.definition: You may cast it for its overload cost to change its 'target' wording to 'each,' affecting everything that qualifies.

splice.definition: As you cast an Arcane spell, you may reveal this from your hand and pay its splice cost to add its text to that spell.

fuse.definition: You may cast both halves of this split card together from your hand.

aftermath.definition: You may cast its second half only from your graveyard, then exile the card.

buyback.definition: Pay the extra buyback cost as you cast it to return it to your hand instead of the graveyard.

assist.definition: Another player may help pay the generic portion of its cost as you cast it.

convoke.definition: You may tap any number of creatures as you cast it; each pays for {1} or one mana of its color.

improvise.definition: You may tap any number of artifacts as you cast it; each pays for {1}.

delve.definition: Each card you exile from your graveyard as you cast it pays for {1}.

affinity.definition: Costs {1} less to cast for each of the named permanent you control.

undaunted.definition: Costs {1} less to cast for each opponent.

crew.definition: Tap any number of creatures with total power equal to or greater than the crew number to turn this Vehicle into an artifact creature until end of turn.

saddle.definition: Tap any number of other creatures with total power N or more to saddle this Mount; its saddled abilities work for the rest of the turn.

living metal.definition: During your turn this Vehicle is also an artifact creature without needing to be crewed.

for mirrodin!.definition: When it enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this Equipment to it.

reconfigure.definition: Pay its reconfigure cost to attach this creature Equipment to another creature, or to unattach it; it's a creature while unattached.

equip.definition: Pay its equip cost to attach this Equipment to a creature you control. Use only as a sorcery.

fortify.definition: Pay its fortify cost to attach this Fortification to a land you control. Use only as a sorcery.

enchant.definition: Describes what this Aura can be attached to (for example, 'enchant creature').

bestow.definition: You may cast it as an Aura for its bestow cost; it becomes a creature again if it becomes unattached.

aura swap.definition: Pay its aura swap cost to exchange this Aura with an Aura card in your hand.

umbra armor.definition: If the enchanted permanent would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura.

cycling.definition: Pay the cycling cost and discard this card to draw a card.

landcycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a land card.

basic landcycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a basic land card.

plainscycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a Plains card.

islandcycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for an Island card.

swampcycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a Swamp card.

mountaincycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a Mountain card.

forestcycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a Forest card.

slivercycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a Sliver card.

wizardcycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a Wizard card.

typecycling.definition: Pay its cost and discard it to search your library for a card of the listed type.

transmute.definition: Pay its transmute cost and discard it to search your library for a card with the same mana value. Use only as a sorcery.

transfigure.definition: Pay its transfigure cost and sacrifice it to search your library for a creature with the same mana value. Use only as a sorcery.

reinforce.definition: Discard it and pay its reinforce cost to put that many +1/+1 counters on a target creature.

scavenge.definition: Exile it from your graveyard and pay its scavenge cost to put that many +1/+1 counters on a creature. Use only as a sorcery.

flashback.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard for its flashback cost, then exile it.

jump-start.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard by paying its cost and discarding a card, then exile it as it resolves.

retrace.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard by also discarding a land card as an additional cost.

escape.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard for its escape cost, which includes exiling cards from your graveyard.

unearth.definition: Pay its unearth cost to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste; exile it at end of turn or when it leaves.

encore.definition: Pay its encore cost and exile it from your graveyard to create a tapped, attacking token copy for each opponent; sacrifice them at the next end step.

embalm.definition: Exile it from your graveyard and pay its embalm cost to create a token copy that is also white.

eternalize.definition: Exile it from your graveyard and pay its eternalize cost to create a 4/4 black token copy.

harmonize.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard for its harmonize cost, tapping creatures to help pay, then exile it.

disturb.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard transformed for its disturb cost.

mayhem.definition: You may cast it from your graveyard for its mayhem cost the turn it was discarded, then exile it.

madness.definition: If you discard this card, you may cast it for its madness cost instead of putting it into your graveyard.

dredge.definition: Instead of drawing a card, you may mill cards equal to its dredge number and return it from your graveyard to your hand.

miracle.definition: If it's the first card you drew this turn, you may reveal it as you draw and cast it for its cheaper miracle cost.

rebound.definition: If you cast it from your hand, exile it instead of putting it in the graveyard; on your next upkeep you may cast it from exile for free.

suspend.definition: Exile it from your hand with time counters; remove one each upkeep, then cast it for free when the last is removed.

foretell.definition: During your turn you may pay {2} to exile it face down; cast it later for its foretell cost.

plot.definition: Pay its plot cost and exile it from your hand any time you could cast a sorcery; cast it for free on a later turn.

warp.definition: You may cast it for its cheaper warp cost; exile it at the next end step, then cast it later from exile for its normal cost.

impending.definition: You may cast it for its impending cost; it enters with N time counters and isn't a creature until the last is removed, one each upkeep.

cipher.definition: After it resolves, you may exile it encoded on a creature you control; whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast the encoded copy for free.

awaken.definition: You may cast it for its awaken cost to also put N +1/+1 counters on a target land and make it a 0/0 creature.

epic.definition: Copy it at the start of each of your upcoming turns for free, but you can't cast other spells for the rest of the game.

split second.definition: While it's on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate non-mana abilities.

gift.definition: As you cast it, you may promise an opponent a gift; if you do, the card's improved effect happens and that opponent gets the gift.

bargain.definition: You may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token as you cast it for an additional effect.

cleave.definition: You may pay the cleave cost to cast it without the text in square brackets.

morph.definition: You may cast it face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}; turn it face up any time by paying its morph cost.

megamorph.definition: You may cast it face down as a 2/2 for {3}; turn it face up by paying its megamorph cost, and it enters with a +1/+1 counter.

disguise.definition: You may cast it face down as a 2/2 with ward {2} for {3}; turn it face up any time by paying its disguise cost.

hideaway.definition: When it enters, look at the top N cards of your library, exile one face down, and put the rest on the bottom; later you may play that card under the stated condition.

forecast.definition: Once each turn during your upkeep, you may reveal it from your hand and pay its forecast cost to use the listed ability.

level up.definition: Pay its cost any time you could cast a sorcery to put a level counter on it, improving its stats and abilities.

monstrosity.definition: Pay its cost to put that many +1/+1 counters on it and make it monstrous, if it isn't already.

outlast.definition: Tap it and pay its outlast cost to put a +1/+1 counter on it. Use only as a sorcery.

adapt.definition: If it has no +1/+1 counters, put that many +1/+1 counters on it.

riot.definition: It enters with your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.

mutate.definition: You may cast it for its mutate cost onto a target non-Human creature, merging them into one creature with all their abilities.

ninjutsu.definition: Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand to put it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

commander ninjutsu.definition: Like ninjutsu, but you may also reveal it from the command zone to swap it in for an unblocked attacker.

exhaust.definition: An activated ability marked exhaust can be used only once each game.

specialize.definition: Pay its specialize cost and discard a card of a chosen color to transform it into that color's specialized side.

craft.definition: Pay its craft cost, which can include exiling other permanents or cards, to transform it. Use only as a sorcery.

prototype.definition: You may cast it as a smaller, differently-costed colored creature with reduced stats instead of its normal artifact form.

more than meets the eye.definition: You may cast it converted to its other face for that face's cost.

compleated.definition: If you pay a Phyrexian mana symbol with life as you cast this planeswalker, it enters with that many fewer loyalty counters.

read ahead.definition: Enters as a Saga with your choice of chapter and adds only that chapter's ability instead of starting at the first.

daybound.definition: A day-and-night card; it stays on its day face and transforms to its night face when it becomes night.

nightbound.definition: The night face of a day-and-night card; it transforms back to its day face when it becomes day.

vanishing.definition: Enters with N time counters; remove one each upkeep, and sacrifice it when the last is removed.

fading.definition: Enters with N fade counters; remove one each upkeep, and sacrifice it when you can't.

cumulative upkeep.definition: At each upkeep, put an age counter on it, then pay its cumulative upkeep cost for each age counter or sacrifice it.

echo.definition: At the first upkeep after it comes under your control, pay its echo cost or sacrifice it.

phasing.definition: During each of your untap steps it phases out if phased in, or phases in if phased out; while phased out it's treated as though it doesn't exist.

absorb.definition: If a source would deal damage to it, prevent N of that damage.

ingest.definition: Whenever it deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top card of their library.

extort.definition: Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B} to drain each opponent 1 life and gain that much life.

living weapon.definition: Enters as a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token with this Equipment attached; if the creature dies, the Equipment stays behind unattached.

ascend.definition: If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.

companion.definition: If your deck meets this card's listed condition, you may pay {3} once per game to put it from outside the game into your hand.

partner.definition: You may have two legendary creatures with partner as your commanders instead of one.

partner with.definition: When it enters, you may search your library for its named partner; the two can be commanders together.

friends forever.definition: You may have two commanders if both have friends forever.

doctor's companion.definition: You may pair this with a legendary Doctor as your two commanders.

choose a background.definition: This commander can pair with a Background enchantment as a second commander.

landwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a land of the listed type.

forestwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Forest.

islandwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls an Island.

swampwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Swamp.

mountainwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Mountain.

plainswalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Plains.

desertwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a Desert.

legendary landwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a legendary land.

nonbasic landwalk.definition: Can't be blocked as long as the defending player controls a nonbasic land.

augment.definition: Reveal it from your hand and pay its augment cost to combine it with a host creature, merging their text.

hidden agenda.definition: As the game begins, secretly name a card; reveal it at any time to apply the effect.

double agenda.definition: A hidden-agenda variant: secretly name two cards as it starts the game face down.

max speed.definition: Has a bonus that's active only while your speed is at its maximum.

station.definition: Tap creatures with total power N or more to place station counters on it; when it reaches counter thresholds it gains the listed abilities or becomes a creature.

double team.definition: When it attacks, if it isn't a token, create or conjure a copy, and it loses double team.

job select.definition: When directed, choose one of its listed jobs to grant that job's ability.

intensity.definition: Tracks an intensity value; its abilities raise or lower that value and check it for stronger effects.

tiered.definition: Choose one of its tiered options as you cast it, paying that tier's cost for a stronger effect at higher tiers.

increment.definition: Increases a tracked value, growing its effect each time it's incremented.

paradigm.definition: Sets or shifts a paradigm condition that changes how its abilities apply.

teamwork.definition: Cooperate with another player as described to share the listed effect.

power-up.definition: Spend resources to power it up for a stronger, upgraded effect.

firebending.definition: Produces the listed firebending effect when triggered (an Avatar bending mechanic), often dealing damage scaled by its number.

sneak.definition: Enter or attack stealthily for the listed benefit, as described on the card.

solved.definition: Once its 'to solve' condition is met, this Case becomes solved and its solved ability turns on.

scry.definition: Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom and the rest back on top in any order.

surveil.definition: Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any of them into your graveyard and the rest back on top in any order.

fateseal.definition: Look at the top N cards of an opponent's library, then put any number on the bottom and the rest back on top in any order.

seek.definition: Find a card matching the description at random from your library and put it into your hand, without searching or shuffling.

mill.definition: Put the top N cards of a library into its owner's graveyard.

explore.definition: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land, put it into your hand; otherwise put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and put the card back on top or into your graveyard.

discover.definition: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value N or less, then cast it for free or put it into your hand; put the rest on the bottom.

manifest.definition: Put the top card of your library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature; turn it face up any time if it's a creature card by paying its mana cost.

manifest dread.definition: Look at the top two cards of your library, put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2, and put the other into your graveyard.

cloak.definition: Put a card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 with ward {2}; turn it face up any time if it's a creature by paying its mana cost.

activate.definition: To use an activated ability by paying its cost (the part before the colon).

cast.definition: To take a spell from where it is, put it on the stack, and pay its costs.

play.definition: To either cast a card as a spell or put a land onto the battlefield.

counter.definition: To cancel a spell or ability on the stack so it doesn't resolve.

attach.definition: To put an Aura, Equipment, or Fortification onto the permanent it affects.

create.definition: To put the described token onto the battlefield.

destroy.definition: To move a permanent to its owner's graveyard (indestructible permanents aren't affected).

sacrifice.definition: To move one of your own permanents to its owner's graveyard; can't be stopped by indestructible.

exile.definition: To move a card or permanent to the exile zone, outside the game until something brings it back.

discard.definition: To move a card from your hand to your graveyard.

reveal.definition: To show a card to all players without changing where it is.

shuffle.definition: To randomize the order of a library.

tap.definition: To turn a permanent sideways, usually as a cost or effect.

untap.definition: To return a tapped permanent to its upright, usable position.

exchange.definition: To swap two things as described, such as life totals or control of permanents.

regenerate.definition: Set up a shield: the next time the permanent would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove it from combat, and heal its damage.

fight.definition: Two creatures each deal damage equal to their power to the other.

goad.definition: The goaded creature must attack each combat if able, and must attack a player other than you.

detain.definition: Until your next turn, the detained permanent can't attack, block, or have its activated abilities used.

support.definition: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures.

bolster.definition: Put N +1/+1 counters on the creature you control with the least power.

amass.definition: Put that many +1/+1 counters on an Army you control, creating a 0/0 black Zombie Army token first if you have none.

proliferate.definition: Choose any number of permanents and players with a counter, then give each another counter of a kind it already has.

populate.definition: Choose a creature token you control and create a copy of it.

incubate.definition: Create an Incubator token with N +1/+1 counters; later pay {2} to transform it into a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature with those counters.

investigate.definition: Create a Clue token: an artifact with '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this: Draw a card.'

food.definition: Create a Food token: an artifact with '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this: Gain 3 life.'

treasure.definition: Create a Treasure token: an artifact with '{T}, Sacrifice this: Add one mana of any color.'

role token.definition: Create an Aura Role token attached to a creature for the listed bonus; a creature can have only one Role you own.

conjure.definition: Create the named card in the specified zone (a digital-only effect).

vote.definition: Each player votes among the listed choices, and the outcome depends on the tally.

clash.definition: You and an opponent each reveal the top card of your library and may put it on the bottom; you benefit if your card's mana value is higher.

meld.definition: Combine two specific cards into a single oversized permanent when their condition is met.

transform.definition: To turn a double-faced permanent to its other face.

convert.definition: To transform a double-faced card to its other side.

time travel.definition: For each suspended card and permanent with time counters you have, add or remove a time counter.

venture into the dungeon.definition: Enter the next room of your dungeon, or the first room of a new one, and follow its instructions.

open an attraction.definition: Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield.

roll to visit your attractions.definition: Roll a six-sided die; if the result matches a number on one of your Attractions, that Attraction's ability triggers.

learn.definition: You may reveal a Lesson card from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.

connive.definition: Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

exert.definition: You may exert it as it attacks; if you do, it won't untap during your next untap step but you get the listed bonus.

suspect.definition: A suspected creature has menace and can't block.

collect evidence.definition: Exile cards with total mana value N or greater from your graveyard to pay a cost.

forage.definition: Pay a cost by either exiling three cards from your graveyard or sacrificing a Food.

endure.definition: Either put N +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, or create an N/N white Spirit creature token.

heist.definition: Carry out a heist as described, exiling or using a card from an opponent.

behold.definition: As an additional cost or condition, reveal from your hand or choose a permanent of the listed type you control.

double.definition: Double the listed quantity, such as life, counters, tokens, or mana.

abandon.definition: Put a face-up plane or phenomenon on the bottom of the planar deck and move to the next plane.

planeswalk.definition: In the Planechase format, move to a new plane card.

set in motion.definition: Put a scheme card from your scheme deck into motion in the Archenemy format.

assemble.definition: Put a Contraption card from your Contraption deck onto the battlefield.

harness.definition: Use the harness ability to fuel or direct the listed effect, as described on the card.

prepared.definition: Ready the listed resource ahead of time for a later benefit, as described on the card.

incorporate.definition: Combine the listed elements into the effect as described on the card.

blight.definition: Apply the listed blight effect, weakening or corrupting the target as described.

waterbend.definition: Produce the listed water-bending effect (an Avatar bending mechanic).

airbend.definition: Produce the listed air-bending effect (an Avatar bending mechanic).

earthbend.definition: Put +1/+1 counters or produce the listed earth-bending effect (an Avatar bending mechanic).

landfall.definition: Has an ability that triggers whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control.

constellation.definition: Has an ability that triggers whenever an enchantment enters the battlefield under your control.

magecraft.definition: Has an ability that triggers whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell.

eerie.definition: Triggers whenever an enchantment enters under your control or a permanent you control is turned face up.

alliance.definition: Triggers whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control.

rally.definition: Triggers whenever it or another Ally enters the battlefield under your control.

enrage.definition: Has an ability that triggers whenever it's dealt damage.

heroic.definition: Has an ability that triggers whenever you cast a spell that targets it.

valiant.definition: Triggers the first time each turn it becomes the target of a spell or ability you control.

battalion.definition: Triggers when it and at least two other creatures attack together.

celebration.definition: Gets a bonus if two or more nonland permanents entered under your control this turn.

flurry.definition: Triggers whenever you cast your second spell each turn.

survival.definition: At the beginning of your second main phase, if you control a tapped creature, you get the listed bonus.

kinship.definition: At the start of your upkeep you may look at the top card of your library; if it shares a creature type with this, reveal it for a bonus.

metalcraft.definition: Gets a bonus while you control three or more artifacts.

threshold.definition: Gets a bonus while seven or more cards are in your graveyard.

delirium.definition: Gets a bonus while four or more card types are among cards in your graveyard.

undergrowth.definition: Its effect scales with the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

spell mastery.definition: Gets a bonus if there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.

hellbent.definition: Gets a bonus as long as you have no cards in hand.

fateful hour.definition: Gets a bonus as long as you have 5 or less life.

revolt.definition: Gets a bonus if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn.

raid.definition: Gets a bonus if you attacked with a creature this turn.

morbid.definition: Gets a bonus if a creature died this turn.

ferocious.definition: Gets a bonus while you control a creature with power 4 or greater.

formidable.definition: Gets a bonus if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater.

coven.definition: Gets a bonus while you control three or more creatures with different powers.

pack tactics.definition: Gets a bonus if you attacked with creatures of total power 6 or greater.

corrupted.definition: Gets a bonus as long as an opponent has three or more poison counters.

adamant.definition: Gets a bonus if at least three mana of the same color was spent to cast it.

addendum.definition: Gets a bonus if you cast it during your main phase.

lieutenant.definition: Gets a bonus as long as you control your commander.

eminence.definition: Has an ability that works even while this commander is in the command zone.

domain.definition: Its effect scales with the number of basic land types among lands you control.

converge.definition: Its effect scales with the number of colors of mana spent to cast it.

chroma.definition: Counts the listed colored mana symbols among cards or permanents to scale its effect.

sweep.definition: Return any number of lands of the named type you control to your hand; the effect scales with how many.

strive.definition: Costs more for each target beyond the first you choose.

imprint.definition: Exile a card to associate it with this permanent; the permanent's ability refers to the exiled card.

grandeur.definition: Discard another card with the same name to use the listed ability.

radiance.definition: Affects the target and every other permanent that shares a color with it.

bloodrush.definition: Discard it and pay its bloodrush cost to give an attacking creature the listed power, toughness, and keywords.

channel.definition: Discard it and pay its channel cost for the listed effect, instead of casting it.

cohort.definition: Tap an untapped Ally you control and this creature to use the listed ability.

join forces.definition: Starting with you, each player may pay into the spell to increase its effect.

tempting offer.definition: You get the effect; each opponent may also choose to get it, and for each who does, you get it an extra time.

parley.definition: Each player reveals the top card of their library; the effect scales with the number of nonland cards revealed.

will of the council.definition: Players vote, and the outcome follows the vote.

council's dilemma.definition: Each opponent votes among the choices, and the result scales with the tally.

will of the planeswalkers.definition: Players vote, and the outcome follows the vote.

secret council.definition: Resolve a secret-council vote or choice among players as described on the card.

underdog.definition: Gets a bonus while you're behind an opponent in the relevant resource, as described on the card.

void.definition: Gets a bonus if a nonland permanent left the battlefield or a spell was warped this turn.

descend.definition: Cares about permanent cards in your graveyard — for example a bonus at four (Descend 4) or eight (Descend 8) or more.

fathomless descent.definition: Scales an effect with the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.

start your engines!.definition: Sets your speed to 1 the first time you'd get it, turning on speed-based abilities.

paradox.definition: Gets a bonus from a paradoxical condition, as described on the card.

disappear.definition: Triggers or benefits when the listed thing leaves or disappears, as described on the card.

renew.definition: Exile it from your graveyard and pay the renew cost for the listed effect, such as distributing +1/+1 counters.

repartee.definition: Triggers from the listed back-and-forth interaction, as described on the card.

opus.definition: An ability tied to building or completing an opus, as described on the card.

infusion.definition: Pay an infusion cost for the listed added effect, as described on the card.

covercast.definition: Cast it under cover for the listed alternative effect, as described on the card.

vivid.definition: Gets a bonus from the listed vivid condition, as described on the card.

legacy.definition: An ability tied to a Legacy or heritage card, as described on the card.

kinfall.definition: Triggers whenever a creature that shares a type enters under your control.

landship.definition: An ability tied to a landship's movement or position, as described on the card.

hero's reward.definition: Grants the listed reward when its hero or quest condition is met.
